mapper.select: SELECT s.*, b.brand_name FROM seller s LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE LOWER(s.email) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brand WHERE brand_name = #{brandName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller WHERE business_number = #{businessNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller WHERE mail_order_number = #{mailOrderNumber}
mapper.insert: SELECT seq_seller.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO seller (seller_id, email, password, business_number, representative_name, mail_order_number, business_address, representative_contact, customer_service_phone, status) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{mailOrderNumber}, #{businessAddress}, #{representativeContact}, #{customerServicePhone}, 'PENDING')
INSERT INTO brand (brand_id, brand_name, seller_id) VALUES (seq_brand.NEXTVAL, #{brandName}, #{sellerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE seller SET password = #{password} WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND password = #{oldPassword}
UPDATE seller SET password = #{password} WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
